title: Boone County Planning Commission — Zoning Map Amendment checklist current source verification
evidenceScope: The preserved Boone County Planning Commission Applications and Forms page directly links this exact PDF in its Checklists section under the label Zoning Map Amendment. On 2026-10-02 the official bcpcky.org URL redirected to the Boone County Planning Commission Revize-hosted PDF and returned HTTP 200 with application/pdf content. The 224612-byte live file was archived with SHA-256 178a3866f8c92a5cd65796c2209bb9a9937b3d7ba3e96e5a6bcf3dd29879803c. This establishes current checklist source identity and current listing only. It does not by itself establish when a zoning map amendment is required, which parcels or jurisdictions it applies to, every checklist instruction, requirement, fee, submission workflow, approval path, or applicability to a particular sign project.
